resources.string: Use a Galaxy routine to switch to Mute or Vibrate only while the camera is open.
Which sound mode should the camera use?

1. In the Routines tab, tap +. Choose the condition for opening an app, then select Camera.

2. Under sound and vibration actions, open the sound mode and volume settings and select %1$s.

3. Set the routine to return to the previous settings when it ends, then save.
When you leave the camera, your previous sound mode returns. If you save both routines, enable only one at a time.
The routines screen could not be opened. Look for Modes and Routines or Bixby Routines in your phone settings.
